lastCompletedStory.title: Ratchet the jscpd threshold down to 4

nextStoryContext: US-003 lowered .jscpd.json threshold from 6 to 4 (config-only change, no dedup work needed: US-001/US-002 already brought src+scripts duplication down to 3.44% duplicated lines, comfortably under 4). Verified `bunx jscpd@5 --config .jscpd.json src scripts` exits 0 at the new threshold, and the full `bun run check:all` spine (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity) is green. All three stories in this PRD (US-001, US-002, US-003) now have passes:true; this was the last story in the PRD, so the next agent invocation should find no non-operator passes:false stories and emit PRD_COMPLETE.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed jscpd v5 threshold reporter semantics match the codebase's existing patterns.md entry: threshold is a config-file number, and the reporter exits 1 only when duplication percentage exceeds it (exit 0 otherwise). Matches the empirically-observed behavior at threshold=4 (exit 0, 3.44-3.52% measured duplication).
